# maxim violation type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:maximViolationType`](gmeow-maximViolationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/maximViolationType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The type of conversational maxim violated in a deceptive event (quality, quantity, relation, manner). Solver-layer classification ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](../classes/gmeow-MaximViolationType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:maximViolationType`](gmeow-maximViolationType.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](../classes/gmeow-MaximViolationType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md), [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](../classes/gmeow-MaximViolationType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify which Gricean maxim a deceptive [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) breaches — naming a [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](../classes/gmeow-MaximViolationType.md) individual; non-functional, so an event that violates several maxims carries each.

### Avoid when

- Avoid expecting the reasoner to derive the violation (it is a solver-layer classification, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid forcing one value — paltering legitimately violates both [`Quantity`](../classes/gmeow-Quantity.md) and Relation.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](../classes/gmeow-MaximViolationType.md) individuals to the deceptive event; let a solver assign them from the held/projected divergence rather than asserting the maxim violation as an entailed fact.

### Examples

- ex:palter [`gmeow:maximViolationType`](gmeow-maximViolationType.md) [`gmeow:maximViolationQuantity`](../individuals/gmeow-maximViolationQuantity.md).
